subtitle: An Island of Stone in a Lake of Time

panels.shot: epic wide aerial, circling above the lake tomb at sunset
panels.action: Sher Shah Suri stands on the stone causeway, looking up at his vast red sandstone island tomb rising from the still lake of Sasaram under a glowing sky.

dialogue.text: In a quiet Bihar valley, Sher Shah Suri raised an island of stone upon water, designing his own resting place and a new language of royal memory.

i18n.hi: शांत बिहार की घाटी में शेरशाह सूरी ने पानी पर पत्थर का टापू उठाया, अपना मज़ार और राजी याद का नया अंदाज़ बनाया।

panels.shot: slow push-in from misty hills to Sasaram lake
panels.action: Morning mist drifts over the unfinished artificial lake at Sasaram, laborers as tiny specks on embankments, while Sher Shah Suri watches from a simple pavilion, wrapped in a cloak.

dialogue.text: Abbas Khan Sarwani writes that Sher Shah never forgot Sasaram, his family home. From here the Sur ruler had risen; here he chose to return in death.

i18n.hi: अब्बास ख़ान सरवानी लिखता है, शेरशाह कभी अपना घर सासाराम नहीं भूला। यहीं से सूर सल्तनत उठी, यहीं मरकर लौटना चुना।

panels.shot: medium profile on Sher Shah, low angle, with site in background
panels.action: Sher Shah Suri holds a rolled plan, gaze steady, as behind him workers measure an octagonal platform taking shape at the lake’s center.

dialogue.text: Victorious over the Mughals and Afghans, he now turned from campaigns to commissions, ordering at Sasaram a tomb unlike any built for a Sultan before.

i18n.hi: मुगलों और अफ़गानों को हराकर अब वो जंग से इमारतों पर मुड़ा, सासाराम में ऐसा मज़ार बनवाया जैसा किसी सुल्तान के लिए पहले न हुआ।

panels.shot: top-down architectural view of sketched octagon over landscape
panels.action: A parchment lies spread on a low table: a bold octagon drawn in dark ink, ringed by smaller chhatri marks, with Sher Shah’s hand resting on its edge.

dialogue.text: Catherine Asher traces its form to Lodi and Afghan prototypes, yet here the octagon grows vast, layered and ringed by water, at a scale not attempted before.

i18n.hi: कैथरीन एशर इसका रूप लोदी और अफ़गान नमूनों से जोड़ती है, पर यहाँ अष्टभुज बहुत फैल जाता है, परतों वाला, पानी से घिरा, ऐसी पैमाने पर जो पहले न देखी गई।

panels.shot: wide shot from lake edge, showing excavation and rising platform
panels.action: Teams of men dig and line the lake’s sides, while stone blocks are ferried on rafts toward a central rising octagonal platform amid the water.

dialogue.text: An artificial lake was cut, embankments raised, the central platform founded on masonry. Stone was asked to float, held firm by geometry and labour.

i18n.hi: कृत्रिम झील खोदी गई, मेड़ें उठीं, बीच का चबूतरा पक्की गारी पर खड़ा हुआ। पत्थर को तैरने को कहा गया, जिसे ज्यामिति और मेहनत ने थामे रखा।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of red sandstone walls climbing upward
panels.action: Red sandstone walls of the octagonal tomb climb tier upon tier, artisans perched on scaffolds carving recesses and mouldings under the watchful eyes of overseers.

dialogue.text: Not marble but dense red sandstone rose at Sasaram, cut into stepped tiers. Afghan severity met Indian ornament on a plan honed by Sultanate builders.

i18n.hi: यहाँ संगमरमर नहीं, घना लाल बलुआ पत्थर उठा, सीढ़ीदार मंज़िलों में कटा। अफ़गान सख़्ती हिंदुस्तानी साज-सज्जा से मिली, सुल्तनत तकनीक से तराशी योजना पर।

panels.shot: close-up of Sher Shah’s face in half-shadow, looking at stone
panels.action: Sher Shah Suri, older now, runs his fingers over a freshly carved cornice, his eyes reflecting both pride and a sober awareness of his own mortality.

dialogue.text: "Let it be strong and plain, yet worthy of the Quran recited within."

i18n.hi: “मज़बूत और सादा हो, लेकिन भीतर पढ़ी जाने वाली कुरान के लायक।”

panels.shot: detail shot of inscription band under construction
panels.action: An artisan kneels on a narrow ledge, chiseling Arabic script into a long sandstone band as another holds the template, while Sher Shah observes from below.

dialogue.text: Quranic verses began to ring the octagon, carved in firm strokes. At Sasaram, faith, kingship and remembrance were bound into stone and water.

i18n.hi: क़ुरान की आयतें अष्टभुज के गिर्द उभरने लगीं, कड़क लकीरों में नक़्क़ाशी हुई। सासाराम में ईमान, बादशाहत और याद पत्थर और पानी में एक-दूसरे से बंध गए।

panels.shot: wide shot from above, showing chhatris and central dome emerging
panels.action: The central dome’s brick shell is being completed, while smaller domed chhatris rise at each corner of the octagon, encircling the main mass like sentinels.

dialogue.text: Earlier Afghan tombs hinted at this form. At Sasaram, the octagon gained a great central dome, its corners crowned with chhatris, making a balanced stone crown.

i18n.hi: पहले अफ़गान मज़ार इस रूप की झलक देते थे। सासाराम में अष्टभुज को विशाल गुम्बद मिला, कोनों पर छतरियाँ सज गईं, जैसे संतुलित पत्थर का ताज।

panels.shot: medium interior shot, under construction prayer hall
panels.action: Inside the bare yet lofty hall, pillars and arches frame an unfinished mihrab, while Sher Shah stands barefoot on the stone floor, testing the echo of a recited verse.

dialogue.text: Within, a single vast chamber opened to prayer. The Tarikh-i-Sher Shahi places his burial here, under a dome where sound would rise and return like a second voice.

i18n.hi: अंदर एक ही बड़ा कमरा नमाज़ को खुला था। तारीख़-ए-शेरशाही उसकी दफ़न इसी में बताती है, ऐसे गुम्बद के नीचे जहाँ आवाज़ उठकर लौटती, दूसरी आवाज़ बनकर।

panels.shot: twilight shot, Sher Shah on causeway, lake partially filled
panels.action: At twilight, Sher Shah walks the stone causeway stretching from shore to tomb, the lake now holding gleaming water that laps quietly against the platform.

dialogue.text: Water was drawn and held, turning the tomb into an island. Asher reads in this lake a deliberate symbol: the ruler resting apart, encircled by reflections and transience.

i18n.hi: पानी खींचकर रोका गया, मज़ार को टापू बनाया गया। एशर इस झील को इशारा पढ़ती है: शासक अलग ठहरा, परछाइयों और फ़ानीपन से घिरा हुआ।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Sher Shah pausing mid-walk, looking back
panels.action: Sher Shah pauses on the causeway, one hand on the parapet, looking back toward the town and hills of Sasaram, then forward toward the looming tomb.

dialogue.text: "From these hills I rose. In these waters I shall sleep."

i18n.hi: “इन पहाड़ियों से मैं उठा हूँ। इन्हीं पानी में मैं सोऊँगा।”

panels.shot: dramatic battlefield wide, distant fort exploding
panels.action: Far from Sasaram, Sher Shah in armor watches from a ridge as smoke billows from a besieged fort, a flash marking the explosion that will soon claim his life.

dialogue.text: In 1545, at Kalinjar, Sher Shah was fatally burned by an exploding mine. He never walked his tomb completed, yet his body was borne back to Sasaram’s lake.

i18n.hi: १५४५ में, कलिंजर पर, शेरशाह एक फटते बारूद से बुरी तरह झुलस गया। अपना पूरा हुआ मज़ार वो कभी न चल सका, पर उसका जिस्म फिर भी सासाराम की झील तक पहुँचा दिया गया।

panels.shot: somber interior of tomb, funeral bier under dome
panels.action: Inside the dim, newly finished hall, Sher Shah’s shrouded bier lies on a simple platform beneath the soaring dome, clerics and courtiers standing in restrained grief.

dialogue.text: Sarwani records his burial at Sasaram. Under the great red dome, the Sur ruler came to rest where he had once traced lines upon parchment.

i18n.hi: सरवानी उसकी दफ़न सासाराम में दर्ज करता है। बड़े लाल गुम्बद के नीचे सूर शासक वहाँ ठहरा जहाँ कभी उसने काग़ज़ पर लकीरें खींची थीं।

panels.shot: serene wide shot from opposite shore, tomb reflected in water
panels.action: Years later, the completed tomb rises in tranquil grandeur, its red sandstone octagon and dome mirrored almost perfectly in the still surface of the lake.

dialogue.text: The Pani Roza stood complete: three-tiered octagon, banded by inscriptions, circled by chhatris, its weight balanced on water. Stone had learned to speak through reflection.

i18n.hi: पानी रोज़ा अब पूरा था: तीन-मंज़िला अष्टभुज, लिखावट की पट्टियों से घिरा, चारों ओर छतरियाँ, उसका बोझ पानी पर सँभला। पत्थर ने परछाई से बोलना सीख लिया था।

panels.shot: comparative aerial imagining Agra with later garden tombs
panels.action: A conceptual aerial view contrasts Sasaram’s island tomb with later Mughal garden tombs on land, trellised paths and symmetrical water channels stretching from gateways.

dialogue.text: Asher shows how Sasaram anticipates Mughal funerary forms, yet differs. Later emperors chose garden grids on land; Sher Shah chose a solitary mass set in a lake.

i18n.hi: एशर दिखाती है कैसे सासाराम मग़ल कब्रिस्तानी रूपों से पहले का इशारा है, पर अलग भी। बाद के बादशाहों ने ज़मीन पर बाग़ी चौरसियाँ चुनीं; शेरशाह ने झील में अकेला भारी पिंड चुना।

panels.shot: close, textured shot of weathered inscription and stone detail
panels.action: Weathered Quranic script and carved mouldings catch light and shadow on aged sandstone, edges softened by time yet still legible and precise.

dialogue.text: The architect’s name is lost to inscription, known only by scholarly inference. But the lines they drew endure in stone, carrying Sher Shah’s memory without signatures.

i18n.hi: मीर की नामपट्टी मिट गई, उसका नाम सिर्फ़ विद्वानों की अटकल में है। पर जो लकीरें उसने खींचीं, पत्थर में बाक़ी हैं, शेरशाह की याद बिना दस्तख़्त उठाए हुए।

panels.shot: modern-day wide shot, visitors crossing causeway to tomb
panels.action: In the present day, diverse visitors walk the old causeway toward the island tomb, some pausing to gaze at the water, others climbing the steps into the hall.

dialogue.text: Today the ASI guards Sasaram’s lake tomb as a monument. Afghan, Sultanate and Indian forms meet there, silently teaching later ages how past rulers imagined death.

i18n.hi: आज एएसआई सासाराम की झील-मज़ार को यादगार की तरह सँभालती है। अफ़गान, सुल्तनत और हिंदुस्तानी रूप वहाँ मिलते हैं, चुपचाप बाद की सदियों को बताते हैं कि पुराने शासक मौत को कैसे देखते थे।

panels.shot: final contemplative wide, tomb at dusk, sky fading to twilight
panels.action: At dusk the tomb stands in quiet silhouette, dome and octagon rising out of a darkening lake, the last light tracing a faint path across the water toward its steps.

dialogue.text: Sher Shah Suri built roads to carry armies and traders, and a lake to receive his body. His tomb at Sasaram asks stone and water to remember what time will erase.

i18n.hi: शेरशाह सूरी ने फ़ौजों और सौदागरों के लिए सड़कें बनाईं, और अपने जिस्म के लिए झील। उसका सासाराम वाला मज़ार पत्थर और पानी से कहता है, जो वक़्त मिटाएगा उसे तुम याद रखो।

subtitle_i18n.en: An Island of Stone in a Lake of Time
subtitle_i18n.hi: पत्थर का टापू, समय की झील
